The '''Vindicator XM-15 [[Brilliant missile|"brilliant" missile]]''' was manufactured by [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]] in the lead up to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was claimed by [[Droid/Legends|droid]]-[[Droid rights/Legends|rights]] activists that the [[Missile/Legends|missile's]] [[Central processor/Legends|central processor]] was so advanced that the entire construct should be considered [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]]. Activists from the [[Mechanical Liberation Front]] attempted to free a shipment of the missiles near [[Havridam City]] on [[New Bakstre]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. During the operation, the activists triggered the missiles' warheads, destroying a twenty-five [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometer]] area of Havridam City and [[Death/Legends|killing]] themselves.
